name: Plane
description: Manages projects, work items, cycles, and wiki pages for software teams via REST API, webhooks, and an official MCP server, with Plane Agents that run assigned recurring work.

skills.name: Work Item Management
skills.description: Creates, lists, searches, updates, and deletes work items, and filters or counts them with Plane Query Language through the API or MCP.

skills.name: Cycles And Modules
skills.description: Plans and tracks work in cycles and modules, including creating, archiving, and adding work items, through the MCP resource tools.

skills.name: Workspace Webhooks
skills.description: Pushes v2 workspace events such as workitem.created to a registered URL with structured payloads for deduplication and diffing.

skills.name: Plane Agents
skills.description: Runs agents that start from assignments, mentions, work-item changes, or schedules and act across Plane projects and connected tools.
